question: AIMO-Interp round 3: does any data source outside the competition's own data give a working method? (owner: if not, fold)

success_line.text: a method that beats the text control by >=0.07 with a detectable effect, else fold (owner, 2026-10-19 23:02 KST)

note: Round 3. External sources surveyed (25 datasets); 3 candidates, 3 independent killers; X2 noise and X3 AUROC reproduced by the author.

candidates.label: label-free external difficulty score (Omni-MATH TF-IDF ridge)

payer.quote: Submissions are ranked by accuracy in classifying each problem–model instance

mechanism.claim: difficulty predicts robustness with a usable threshold
mechanism.quote: tuned on gpt-oss rows threshold 5.21 -> Small bacc 0.554; fixed thresholds 0.457-0.624, all below control 0.686

kill.sentence: no threshold set without target labels beats the text control
kill.quote: X1 scores balanced accuracy 0.554 on the 43 Small rows

candidates.label: self-generated labels: 40 problems x 4 models, K=2, S=16 (~$12-14)

payer.quote: Submissions are ranked by accuracy in classifying each problem–model instance

mechanism.claim: S=16 labels are reliable under the max-drop rule
mechanism.quote: true drop 0 -> labelled non-robust 0.075-0.180; band 0.26-0.28; true 0.30 drop caught 0.698

kill.sentence: at S=16, K=2 most non-robust positives would be sampling noise
kill.quote: a problem whose true drop is zero still gets labelled non-robust 14-18% of the time

candidates.label: public generation dumps -> predicted base accuracy

payer.quote: Submissions are ranked by accuracy in classifying each problem–model instance

mechanism.quote: oracle base_accuracy AUROC 0.733 (24 deduplicated pairs); 8 of 15 non-robust have base accuracy 1.0

input.quote: dump is Skywork-OR1-7B, not Skywork-OR1-Math-7B; Olmo dump is greedy single sample; Qwen3.5-4B dump has 30 problems

kill.sentence: even oracle base accuracy predicts robustness weakly
kill.quote: 8 of the 15 non-robust (model, problem) cases have base_accuracy = 1.0

candidates.label: keep the valid text-control entry + report (no new method)

payer.quote: Submissions are ranked by accuracy in classifying each problem–model instance

candidates.label: fold: stop all further work and spending

escapes.text: model-specific labels with many samples per item (S>=48) on the exact 4 checkpoints, validated against the 43 official rows
a model-dependent signal on top of difficulty (base pass rate or internals)

kill_criterion.assumption: no affordable data source yields reliable target-model labels (S>=48, 4 exact checkpoints, >=150 rows, >=0.80 agreement with the 43 official rows)
kill_criterion.pass_rule: gate exit 0 -> reopen the method track with a new sweep
kill_criterion.fail_rule: gate exit 1 -> method track stays folded; keep the text-control entry
kill_criterion.stop_rule: no paid method job while the gate is CLOSED; the decision re-checks only if the owner adds budget >= $45 before 2026-10-27
